text: American psychologist John Holden comes to England to expose Julian Karswell's Satanic cult, and scoffs at the death of a rival who saw [a gigantic demon rise from a cloud of smoke|threat|the devil and dark gods]. Karswell conjures [a sudden windstorm at a children's Halloween party|images|weather, sky and darkness], then secretly passes Holden [a parchment of runic writing|origin|curses laid by others] and tells him [he will die in three days|rules|death on a deadline]. With Harrington's niece Joanna, Holden follows the runes to Stonehenge, a séance and a catatonic man who once held the same paper.
